variants.name: Head tilt
variants.desc: Tilts its head, one eye wider than the other, and a question mark pops up.

variants.name: Look around
variants.desc: Wide eyes dart left, right and up, the body turning to follow.

variants.name: Dizzy
variants.desc: Eyes swirl in opposite circles while stars orbit its head.

variants.name: Lean in
variants.desc: Leans in close, eyes wide, and blinks twice. Something caught its eye.

variants.name: Inspect
variants.desc: Sweeps a magnifying glass across its face; each eye swells under the lens.
